question: Can you figure out the average difference in pageviews between users who bought something and those who didn’t in December 2020? Just label anyone who was involved in purchase events as a purchaser.
sql:
WITH 
-- Get all unique users in December 2020
all_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
-- Count pageviews per user in December 2020
pageview_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    COUNT(*) AS pageviews
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
-- Identify purchasers in December 2020
purchasers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND event_name = 'purchase'
)
-- Calculate average pageviews for each group and the difference
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(pv.pageviews, 0) END) AS avg_pageviews_purchasers,
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.user_pseudo_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(pv.pageviews, 0) END) AS avg_pageviews_non_purchasers,
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(pv.pageviews, 0) END) - 
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.user_pseudo_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(pv.pageviews, 0) END) AS avg_difference
FROM all_users u
LEFT JOIN pageview_counts pv ON u.user_pseudo_id = pv.user_pseudo_id
LEFT JOIN purchasers p ON u.user_pseudo_id = p.user_pseudo_id
